description: This Java class 'ContentFiles' is a data holder used in the admin web interface of a Shopizer project. It encapsulates form data related to uploading content files (such as images or documents) for a merchant, including a list of MultipartFile objects and a filename. The class includes validation annotations and serves as a wrapper for cache storage of content images.

classes.name: ContentFiles
classes.description: A bean class responsible for handling form data for uploading content files in the shop admin, including validation and serialization.

methods.name: setFile
methods.description: Sets the list of MultipartFile objects representing uploaded files.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Retrieves the list of uploaded MultipartFile objects.

methods.name: setFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename associated with the uploaded files.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Retrieves the filename associated with the uploaded files.
